summary: Iteration 70 — verified Zenrex linear storage pricing (PayPal-only) end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (4 existing + 7 new regression). Frontend: /billing/storage renders all 8 plan cards with linear pricing schedule, s100 highlighted, Arabic explanatory text present, and CTA click triggers /api/storage/checkout (busy spinner visible).

issues: Page makes 12 network calls (3 fetches × 4 reload cycles) on initial mount — likely React StrictMode double-mount + URL params re-trigger. Not breaking, but wasteful. Consider de-duping the reload trigger in useEffect.

verified_endpoints: POST /api/payments/paypal/create → 200 with approval_url=https://www.paypal.com/... (universal endpoint regression fixed — UniversalCreateIn now resolves)
POST /api/storage/capture → endpoint exists (404 record-not-found, NOT route-missing)
GET /api/storage/subscription → 200 with plan_id, plan_quota_mb, status (auth required)
verified_ui_elements: All 8 plan cards rendered with data-testid storage-plan-{free,s50,s100,s150,s200,s300,s500,s1000}
Arabic explanatory text 'تسعير خطي بسيط: 10 ميجا مجاناً، ثم $5 لكل 50 ميجا إضافية.' present
CTA click (data-testid storage-plan-cta-s50) triggers /api/storage/checkout (busy spinner shown on button)
Free plan shows 'باقتك الحالية' (current plan) badge for owner@zerax.com

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA confirmed by passing test_paypal_universal_endpoint_works: UniversalCreateIn was defined INSIDE register_payments() — FastAPI's dependency injection couldn't resolve the Pydantic type during route registration (raised NameError), causing register_payments to never include the router, hence 404 on /api/payments/paypal/create. Fix (already applied) — moved UniversalCreateIn (and StorageCaptureIn) to module level so FastAPI can resolve them when reflecting on the endpoint signature. Same pattern was the right call for any future Pydantic schemas used in nested register_* factories.
